div.p: At Justo Realfintech, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our real estate app. By using the app, you agree to the terms of this policy.
We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when you use the app, including but not limited to:

ul.li: Contact Information: Name, email address, phone number.
Location Data: GPS location for displaying nearby properties.
Property Preferences: Type of properties you are interested in (e.g., apartment, house, budget range).
Usage Data: Details about how you interact with the app (pages visited, search queries, property views).
To provide and personalize the app’s services.
To send notifications about property listings and updates.
To improve functionality and user experience.
To communicate regarding inquiries or support requests.
To analyze usage trends and enhance performance.

div.p: We implement industry-standard security measures to safeguard your personal information. However, please note that no method of data transmission over the internet is completely secure. While we strive to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.
We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following circumstances:

ul.li: With third-party service providers who assist in operating the app (e.g., cloud hosting, payment processors).
To comply with legal obligations or protect our rights and safety.

div.p: Our app may use cookies to enhance your experience, such as remembering preferences and improving performance. You can disable cookies in your device settings, though this may affect some features.
The app may contain links to third-party websites or services not operated by us. We are not responsible for their privacy practices and recommend reviewing their policies before sharing information.

You may access, update, or delete your personal information by contacting us through the app or via our support email at cs@justo.co.in. You may also opt out of receiving promotional emails at any time.

Our app is not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have collected information from a child under 13, please contact us immediately.
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be reflected in the app, and the date of the most recent update will be indicated above.
If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at cs@justo.co.in.
